analysis.insight_summary: Users wishing to upgrade [product_name] Soft Comfort from [version_no] to [version_no] experienced uncertainty around the process and availability. Initial confusion about upgrade possibilities led to fragmented information, but some users confirmed a free online upgrade through the software itself. Users were advised to follow official sources or use support features in the product, resulting in an inconsistent experience when searching for upgrade options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect transparent, official details regarding upgrade availability, a direct and uncomplicated upgrade process, and clarification about any related costs.
